notes: Restraint-only. Registry models trimmed 20->11, keeping only representative endings already in the old data. Institutional or eligibility-only endings dropped to this note: .edu (EDUCAUSE), .aero (SITA), .bank (fTLD), .coop (DotCooperation), plus .cat and Nominet's minor second-level UK endings (.org.uk, .ltd.uk, .me.uk, .net.uk). Needs web pass: the brief's representative set also names .net, .org, .io, .co and .eu, which are absent from the old data and were not added. Old kind had no source; s left empty as before. Gap pass 2026-10-27: added .net (Verisign), .org (Public Interest Registry), .io (Internet Computer Bureau Ltd), .co (.CO Internet S.A.S.) and .eu (EURid) as endings; registries per the Wikipedia List of Internet top-level domains and the .net, .io, .co and .eu pages (retrieved and logged; the IANA root database page itself was not fetched).
